channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Anti-ICE rallies planned at Home Depot locations across S.D. County
item.description: The anti-ICE rallies include San Diego communities, Chula Vista, Escondido, Lemon Grove, Poway, Santee and more.

item.title: San Diego Central Jail inmate’s death ruled accidental OD
item.description: The medical examiner's office determined that Brandon Pleffner's death was caused by the effects of fentanyl and methamphetamine.

item.title: Students take on mental health for middle school students as part of community service project
item.description: Working individually or in small groups, Pacific Beach Middle School students select a topic that will result in a larger community benefit.

item.title: Marine F-35C stealth jets from Miramar involved in Iran strikes
item.description: Marine Corps F-35C stealth jets from Miramar were among the aircraft that struck Iran during attacks by the U.S. and Israel.

item.title: Opinion: Mentors matter in education and work because success is rarely a solo act
item.description: In San Diego, the question is not whether mentorship matters, but whether we take responsibility for sustaining it in education and work afterward.

item.title: Padres’ Cronenworth, Pivetta on baseball labor fight: Salary cap is a nonstarter
item.description: The union has argued a salary cap, which the owners may seek, doesn’t provide any more competitive balance than the current luxury tax.

item.title: Meet Alain Raymond, one of San Diego County’s most decorated physician assistants
item.description: Alain Raymond, a cardiothoracic surgical physician assistant-certified (PA-C) and U.S. Navy veteran based in San Diego's East County, was recently named the “Locum Tenens Provider of the Year.”

item.title: Boyfriend suspected in death of woman found in Colina del Sol apartment
item.description: The woman, described as being in her 30s, was taken from the Colina del Sol residence to a hospital, where doctors pronounced her dead.

item.title: Christian St. Croix steps up as first artist ambassador for San Diego Theatre Month
item.description: Theatre Month, starting Sunday, offers discount tickets, beginning at $15, for a range of plays, musicals and special performances.

item.title: Factory-built housing can be found in San Diego. But region and state may be ready to get really ‘modular curious’
item.description: State legislators believe the turning point might actually be here for modular homes. They want to make 2026 the Year of the Housing Factory.
